scope: Exactly nine Hymns (1985) records; no generated harmony or application changes
finding: All nine authoritative bundled MusicXML sources lack harmony elements and chord-text annotations. Visual review of all 14 bundled PDF pages also found no printed chord symbols. No approved generated overlays exist for these IDs.
historicalEvidence: reports/harmony-pilot.json records all nine as status none with zero harmony and empty chordText.

reports/hymnal-1985-validation-matrix.json records source notation rendering/transposition/playback passes. Earlier Melody eligibility failures are separate from chord extraction. No reproducible chord-parser failure was established for these nine.
currentUI: app.js syncScoreView requires preparedHasChords for Full/Transpose. The option remains unavailable for these nine; Original PDF and Melody only work. Melody key changes remain available.
correction: None: do not infer arrangements from staff notes or alter the existing view-availability policy.
playback: Uses transposed source notes, not chord-symbol accompaniment. Written-order timeline; no new repeat or accompaniment engine.
